Container.Name: tidal-playlist-bridge
Container.Overview: Import TIDAL, Spotify and YouTube Music playlists, or Pandora listens scrobbled to ListenBrainz. Review requests, post to Discord with !requestlist, then enable !auto on.

Config.Name: App data
Config.Description: TIDAL OAuth session and local configuration

Config.Name: ListenBrainz token
Config.Description: Used only for confirmed historical listens

Config.Name: Spotify redirect URI
Config.Description: Exact registered callback. For HTTP loopback, use the SSH tunnel described in README.

Config.Name: Spotify refresh token (optional)
Config.Description: Optional pre-authorized refresh token; otherwise use Connect Spotify.

Config.Name: YouTube Music client ID
Config.Description: Google OAuth client ID for TVs and Limited Input devices. Enable YouTube Data API v3.

Config.Name: YouTube Music browser auth file (optional)
Config.Description: Optional container path to ytmusicapi browser.json, e.g. /config/youtube-browser.json. Overrides device OAuth.

Config.Name: Pandora ListenBrainz username (optional)
Config.Description: Account receiving your Pandora scrobbles. Defaults to ListenBrainz username above. No Pandora password is needed.

Config.Name: Pandora history limit
Config.Description: Maximum Pandora listens to load (1-1000), scanning up to 10000 recent ListenBrainz listens.

Config.Name: Secure OAuth cookies (HTTPS proxy)
Config.Description: Set true when accessing through an HTTPS reverse proxy. Leave false for plain HTTP LAN or loopback access.
